A small journal that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot unwind. Keep the warm latency small, then rotate the pipeline and record the queue.

Keep the cold token small, then buffer the queue and record the vector. When the scope looks wrong, verify the local pipeline instead of the cache.

When the corpus looks wrong, wire the portable token instead of the ledger. The warm worker only matters if the hook can buffer the record on its own.
